clue.text: Reuters with test page oddly going wrong for sensationalist rags

indicators.note: something going wrong goes awry, so the letters of the news agency and the picked letters are put into a new order
oddly asks for the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of the words test page

explanation.surface: A sloppy wire-service proof page turns a respectable agency's copy into tabloid trash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' takes TSPG from 'test page'; 'going wrong' shuffles those with REUTERS.
explanation.definitionFit: The gutter press is the collective name for scandal-hungry tabloid newspapers, the rags.

clue.text: Some chores unfortunately upset employer

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the run of letters reads from the bottom up
some of the words means only part of their letters are taken

explanation.surface: A boss is annoyed about how badly the household tasks were done.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' takes RESU from 'choRES Unfortunately'; 'upset' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who uses something or someone, such as a drug or a tool, is a user; an employer makes use of staff.

clue.text: Grave disease consumes old male

indicators.note: one thing consuming another takes it inside, so the abbreviation for the disease swallows the other letters

parts.note: TB is the abbreviation for tuberculosis, a disease once called consumption

explanation.surface: A serious illness is wasting away an elderly man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grave' looks like an adjective meaning serious, but it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A tomb is a burial place, the same thing as a grave.

clue.text: Renegade said run away from verminous parasite

parts.note: a rat is someone who deserts or betrays their side

indicators.note: said marks that the following word is to be heard spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: to flee is to run away

explanation.surface: A traitor is told to escape from some disgusting bloodsucker.
explanation.definitionFit: The rat flea is the insect that lives on rats and spread plague.

clue.text: Outdated feeling of pity for biblical woman

definitions.meaning: an archaic word for compassion or pity, surviving in ruthless
The Moabite woman whose story is told in the Old Testament book named after her

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned compassion felt for a woman from scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: The archaic noun for pity and the Old Testament heroine share one spelling.

clue.text: Inaugurated showing the effects of age involved in moral shortcoming

indicators.note: being involved in something here means placed within it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a sin is a moral failing
something worn shows wear from long use

explanation.surface: A new official, already looking tired, is caught up in some ethical lapse.
explanation.definitionFit: An official is formally installed in office by taking an oath, so inaugurated.

clue.text: Wise specialist mostly sorted out niece and daughter

indicators.note: mostly means nearly all, so the last letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: an expert is a specialist

indicators.note: sorted out means put in order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A knowledgeable consultant mostly dealt with a family matter involving niece and daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims EXPERT to EXPER; 'sorted out' turns NIECE into IENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Wise here means seasoned and knowing through practice, the sense of experienced.

clue.text: Related to subversive activities of a French revolutionary uprising with foundation's support

indicators.note: in a down clue the support goes underneath, so this piece comes last

parts.note: un is the French for a

indicators.note: in a down clue an uprising reads from the bottom up, so the word is turned round

parts.note: a red is a revolutionary communist
ground is the foundation, the base layer, as in groundwork

explanation.surface: A rebellion in France backed by some founding body, all linked to covert resistance.
explanation.definitionFit: The underground is a secret resistance movement, so the adjective describes clandestine subversion.

clue.text: Fox and domestic fowl, headless farm animals

indicators.note: both words lose their heads, so the first letter of each is removed

parts.note: a hen is a domestic fowl

explanation.surface: A fox and a chicken, both decapitated, are found among the livestock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'headless' removes F from FOX and H from HEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Oxen are cattle kept for work on the farm, livestock animals.

clue.text: Importunate about change in condition

indicators.note: about means turned around and moved about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone pestering keeps going on about a change in their circumstances.
explanation.definitionFit: A permutation is a variation or altered arrangement of something, a change in its state.

clue.text: Somewhat degenerate element of heredity

indicators.note: somewhat means only part of the word, so the run of letters inside it is taken

explanation.surface: A slightly corrupt unit passed down through generations.
explanation.definitionFit: A gene is the unit of inheritance carried on chromosomes.

clue.text: Alliance when very good intelligence agency stands over state missing two leaders

indicators.note: in a down clue standing over means placed above, so what comes earlier sits on top

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
so is an old exclamation of approval, meaning very good or that will do
the CIA is the US Central Intelligence Agency

indicators.note: the first two letters of the synonym are dropped

parts.note: a nation is a state

explanation.surface: A pact formed when an excellent spy service supervises a state lacking two of its chiefs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing two leaders' cuts NATION to TION.
explanation.definitionFit: An association is a body of people joined for common purpose, an alliance.

clue.text: Endless training with supporter in a workable manner

indicators.note: without its end, so the last letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: practice is training by repetition
an ally is a supporter

explanation.surface: Training without end alongside a backer gets things done in a usable way.
explanation.definitionFit: Practically means in a way that is realistic and functional, so workably.

clue.text: Bands associated with stars

definitions.meaning: the US flag is the Stars and ..., so ... go with stars

explanation.surface: Musical groups linked to celebrity performers.
explanation.definitionFit: Stripes are narrow bands, and they pair with stars in the American flag's name.

clue.text: Small parasites that infest piece of bread

parts.note: lice are small parasitic insects that infest hair and skin

explanation.surface: Tiny bugs have got into a bit of the loaf.
explanation.definitionFit: A slice is a thin cut piece of a loaf.

clue.text: Conservative admitted to being pleased with defeat

indicators.note: being admitted to a place means let inside it, so the letter goes within the word

parts.note: liking is being pleased with something

explanation.surface: A Tory got into a club he enjoyed, then took a beating.
explanation.definitionFit: A licking is informal for a thrashing or heavy defeat.

clue.text: Empty little liquid measure accepted by law

indicators.note: an emptied word has its inside removed, keeping only its outermost letters

parts.note: gal is the abbreviation for gallon, a measure of liquid

explanation.surface: A tiny drinks measure, emptied, passes muster with the authorities.
explanation.definitionFit: Legal means permitted or recognised under statute.

clue.text: A property right for foreigner?

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to keep someone's property until a debt is paid

explanation.surface: Can someone from abroad hold rights over real estate?
explanation.definitionFit: An alien is a person from another country, a foreign national.

clue.text: Fierce monster or moggie with tail docked

indicators.note: docking a tail cuts it off, so the last letter of the word goes

parts.note: moggie is British slang for a cat, especially an ordinary one

explanation.surface: Which is the savage beast: a monster or a cat with a cropped tail?
explanation.walkthrough: 'with tail docked' cuts CAT to CA.
explanation.definitionFit: The orca, or killer whale, is a large predatory sea creature.

clue.text: Let loose frisky hound abandoning start of house-training

indicators.note: a frisky dog jumps about, so the letters of the word are mixed up, with 'abandoning' leaving one letter out
the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A playful dog that gave up on toilet training is let off the lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'frisky' shuffles HOUND; 'abandoning' drops the H that 'start of house-training' supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: To undo a knot or fastening is to untie it, letting it loose.

clue.text: Discard back to front gambling game

indicators.note: the back letter is moved to the front of the word

parts.note: craps is a dice game played for money

explanation.surface: Throw out a betting game from end to end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back to front' moves the final S of CRAPS to the start.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrap something is to throw it away or abandon it.

clue.text: Unfamiliar street limits

parts.note: a range is the span between limits, as in a price range

explanation.surface: A road's boundaries are not ones I know.
explanation.definitionFit: Strange means not known or encountered before.

clue.text: Decorator's suffering — short term

definitions.note: the clue's apostrophe-s is read as 'is', linking definition and wordplay

parts.note: pain is suffering

indicators.note: short means cut, so the last letter of the word is lost

explanation.surface: A house painter is having a brief spell of agony.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter is a tradesman who paints and wallpapers rooms, a decorator.

clue.text: Strive to be like one friend possessing sex appeal

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: possessing something means holding it, so the other piece sits inside

parts.note: mate is British informal for a friend
it is an old slang term for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Copy a single pal who is irresistibly attractive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' for sex appeal is dated slang from the 1920s, as in the 'It girl'.
explanation.definitionFit: To imitate someone is to copy them, trying to be like them.

clue.text: Type of light lake punt Royal Navy pursues

indicators.note: one thing pursuing another comes after it, so this piece goes last

parts.note: punt is a bet, and an ante is a stake put up in poker

explanation.surface: Sailors chase a flat-bottomed boat on a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'punt' looks like the boat on the lake but is a bet.
explanation.definitionFit: A lantern is an enclosed portable lamp.

clue.text: Detestable person kicked, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard spoken, so a word with the same sound is entered

parts.note: toed means kicked with the toe

explanation.surface: A hateful man got a boot, it is said.
explanation.definitionFit: A toad is a contemptible, repulsive person.

clue.text: Continue to make brief look from below

indicators.note: in a down clue reading from below means bottom to top, so the word is turned round

parts.note: a peek is a quick look

explanation.surface: Carry on taking a quick look upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep doing something is to continue it.

clue.text: Gold-coloured young sow

definitions.meaning: covered in gold or gold in colour
a young female pig that has not yet farrowed

explanation.surface: A golden young pig.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective for gilded and the farming term for a young female pig share a spelling.

clue.text: Reportedly make acceptable one-room dwelling

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the word is to be heard rather than read

parts.note: to sell an idea is to make it acceptable to others

explanation.surface: Supposedly a tiny flat has been made fit to live in.
explanation.definitionFit: A cell is a small single room, as for a monk or prisoner.

clue.text: Haplessly indeterminate, I'm reflecting lacking provided food and drink

indicators.note: haplessly means unluckily, as if knocked about, so the letters are rearranged
reflecting means mirrored, so the two letters are read backwards

explanation.surface: Uncertain and unfortunate, I'm deep in thought about something missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' is the instruction to remove those reflected letters from the anagram's pool before rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: To entertain guests is to give them hospitality, food and drink.

clue.text: Birds giving distressed cries not initially heard

indicators.note: not means without, so the letter is taken away

parts.note: howls are loud cries of pain or distress

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Birds making wails of grief were not heard at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes the H that 'initially heard' supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: Owls are nocturnal birds of prey.

clue.text: In resort, replayed set extremely badly

indicators.note: resort means to sort again, so these letters are put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: At a holiday spot, a tennis set that was played again went terribly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday place but is re-sort, the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Desperately is an intensifier for something very bad, as in desperately ill.
